sources.title: Human History Map historical-basemap civilization index
sources.note: Exact indexed row checked for id cheras, label Cheras, approximate 500 to 800 CE dates, no aliases and historical-basemaps provenance.

sources.title: Human History Map imported summary ledger
sources.note: Imported Wikipedia summary checked as an evidence lead; its early-historic description does not match the indexed late-antique interval.

sources.title: Human History Map research coverage ledger
sources.note: Coverage record checked for two non-contiguous observed intervals, two border files, missing card and unreviewed identity, chronology and border fields.

sources.title: Human History Map world-400 topology
sources.note: Decoded predecessor seam checked for target absence and broad hindu-kingdoms ownership of most fixed South Indian probes.

sources.title: Human History Map world-500 topology
sources.note: Decoded first target polygon checked for exact properties, bounds, coordinate hash, topology arcs, shared neighbors and fixed point probes.

sources.title: Human History Map world-600 topology
sources.note: Decoded gap seam checked for target absence and replacement by broad or neighboring atlas features.

sources.title: Human History Map world-700 topology
sources.note: Decoded second target polygon checked for exact properties, bounds, coordinate hash, topology arcs, shared neighbors and fixed point probes.

sources.title: Human History Map world-800 topology
sources.note: Decoded indexed endpoint seam checked for target absence and Pallava, Pandya and Rashtrakuta assignments across audited places.

sources.title: Human History Map world-900 topology
sources.note: Decoded post-endpoint comparison checked for continued target absence despite the documented Chera Perumal state by this century.

sources.title: Human History Map world-1000 topology
sources.note: Decoded long-after comparison checked for target absence and Chola Empire ownership of most audited southern places.

sources.title: Shinu Anna Abraham, Chera, Chola, Pandya: archaeological evidence and early Tamil kingdoms
sources.note: Peer-reviewed Asian Perspectives study checked for the c. 300 BCE to 300 CE archaeological horizon and the need to keep literary, inscriptional and material identities analytically distinct.

sources.title: Ophira Gamliel, Judaism in South India, 849 to 1489
sources.note: Cambridge book listing checked for the mid-ninth- to late-twelfth-century Chera Perumal state-formation horizon and its separation from early Chera evidence.

sources.title: IGNOU, Early Tamil Society: Regions, Cultures and Hero Worship
sources.note: University teaching unit checked for source criticism, landscapes, occupations, exchange, polity, warriors, bards and hero-stone commemoration in early Tamilakam.

sources.title: INFLIBNET, The Sangam Age
sources.note: University chapter checked for debated literary chronology, Chera-Chola-Pandya politics, court offices, warfare, crops, ports, crafts and social categories.

sources.title: INFLIBNET, South Indian Kingdoms: Pallavas and Chalukyas
sources.note: University chapter checked for the sixth- to eighth-century regional political setting dominated in its sources by Pallava-Chalukya conflict and multiple land-grant states.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, Chera Site Museum at Karur
sources.note: Official museum account checked for Pugalur genealogy, Jain donation, Karur excavations, Roman coins, stones, ceramics, amphorae, bricks and iron.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, Pugalur rock beds and inscriptions
sources.note: Official monument record checked for the cave setting, Jain beds, royal Chera genealogy, merchant names and broad inscriptional dating.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, Tamil-Brahmi Script
sources.note: Official epigraphy page checked for Tamil-Brahmi chronology, inscription settings and the second-century-CE Pugalur example.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, Kalvettiyal epigraphy manual
sources.note: Official manual checked for its normalized Tamil reading of the Pugalur genealogy and discussion connecting inscriptional names with literary traditions.

sources.title: Unicode Standard 17.0, Brahmi code chart
sources.note: Official character chart checked for Brahmi vowel signs and the dedicated Old Tamil consonant and virama code points used in the cautious Unicode rendering.

sources.title: Central Institute of Classical Tamil, Early Tamil Epigraphy
sources.note: Government research institute catalogue checked for Mahadevan's corpus scope, Tamil-Brahmi cave inscriptions, transliteration, translation and sixth-century endpoint.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu State Archaeology, Inscribed Potsherds of Tamil Nadu, volume 1
sources.note: Official digital publication checked for Karur excavation history, Makkotai coin reporting and the warning that many riverbed coins lack stratified contexts.

sources.title: Karur District Government, History
sources.note: District government history checked for Karur finds including pottery, brick, toys, amphorae, rings and coins, while treating its confident capital claim cautiously.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, excavated sites
sources.note: Official excavation register checked for Karur's 1973 to 1974 and 1994 to 1995 seasons and classification as an Early Historic site.

sources.title: Kerala Council for Historical Research, Pattanam Excavations 2008 manual
sources.note: Official field manual checked for excavation objectives, multidisciplinary method, long chronology, maritime questions and the still-open task of locating Muziris.

sources.title: Mahatma Gandhi University museum, Early Historic Pattanam collection
sources.note: University museum account checked for site chronology, sweet water, botanical remains, brick and roof architecture, toilets, ring wells, industries and imported containers.

sources.title: Kerala Tourism, Pattanam archaeological site
sources.note: Official heritage account checked for continuous settlement, wharf and canoe context, pottery, toilet features, ring wells and cautious possible identification with Muziris.

sources.title: UCL South Asian Archaeology, Indian Ocean commerce and western India
sources.note: University archaeology paper checked for Pattanam surface finds, trial excavation, imports, brick architecture, roof tiles, ring wells and spindle whorls.

sources.title: Antiquity, External Connections of Early Historic Pattanam
sources.note: Peer-reviewed project report checked for ceramic evidence, Pattanam's discovery, chronology and long-distance links without making pottery equal political control.

sources.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Year One: Art of the Ancient World
sources.note: Museum publication checked for monsoon sailing, Muziris cargoes, Malabar pepper, ivory, gems, textiles and Mediterranean demand.

sources.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art, Tree and Serpent trade guide
sources.note: Museum exhibition guide checked for west-coast exports, Roman-world exchange and the first-century-CE peak in luxury trade.

sources.title: BEADS, stone beads, debitage and raw materials from Pattanam
sources.note: Specialist journal study checked for finished beads, manufacturing debris, raw materials and the distinctiveness of Pattanam's assemblage.

sources.title: UCL Discovery, rice agriculture in Iron Age and Early Historic South India
sources.note: University repository article checked for archaeobotanical evidence and the caution needed before assuming one uniform irrigation regime across South India.

sources.title: PAMA, Pattanam Unearthed excavation catalogue
sources.note: Archaeological institute catalogue checked for plant remains, wharf context, kiln, toilets, ring wells, roofing, bead and craft evidence, and religious-evidence limits.

sources.title: Patiṟṟuppattu, original Tamil and English translation by Vaidehi Herbert
sources.note: Primary literary collection and modern translation checked for Chera praise poetry, war, agriculture, food, female performers, music, clothing and courtly generosity.

sources.title: Project Madurai, Patiṟṟuppattu Tamil electronic text
sources.note: Open scholarly Tamil e-text checked as an original-language witness to the received poem collection, with later compilation and edition limits preserved.

sources.title: Project Madurai, Patiṟṟuppattu plain Tamil electronic text
sources.note: Separate open Tamil e-text checked for the cited war, dress, meal and performance verses; it witnesses the received collection rather than an ancient manuscript.

sources.title: Central Institute of Classical Tamil, digital manuscript and poetry archive
sources.note: Government institute archive checked for surviving manuscript editions, classical poetry tools, women's voices and the difference between old composition and later witnesses.

sources.title: IGNCA and ASI, Minor Rock Edicts of Asoka and connected problems
sources.note: Official scholarly publication checked for Ashoka's Keralaputra reference and the interpretation of southern polities as outside Mauryan dominion.

sources.title: Colorado State University, translations of Ashoka's edicts
sources.note: University-hosted translation checked for Rock Edict II's Keralaputra passage about treatments, useful plants, roadside wells and trees.

sources.title: Indian Journal of History of Science, Physicians of Ancient India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed medical history checked for healing evidence, practitioners and the later compilation histories of the Charaka and Sushruta traditions.

sources.title: Ophira Gamliel, Jewish Maritime Networks in Old Malayalam Inscriptions
sources.note: Cambridge chapter checked for eighth-century temple-village change, 849 Kollam plates and mid-ninth- to late-twelfth-century Chera Perumal state formation.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, inscriptions in Tamil script
sources.note: Official epigraphy overview checked for Tamil-Brahmi, Grantha, Tamil and Vattezhuthu chronology and regional variation.

sources.title: National Mission on Monuments and Antiquities, Indian Archaeology reviews
sources.note: National archaeological index checked for the availability of annual excavation reviews and the need to tie finds to reported seasons and contexts.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Department of Archaeology, ring wells at Keeladi
sources.note: Official excavation note checked as a wider Tamilakam comparison for constructed wells, decoration and the limits of transferring evidence between sites.
